working_on.feature: Excel Medicine Import & Smart Stock Reconciliation
working_on.task: All phases implemented, verified via test suites, and build validated
working_on.notes: Full end-to-end integration: 'Nhập thuốc' button, accessible drag-and-drop file upload dialog, 4-tier pharmaceutical matching engine with LASA dosage protection, interactive 3-tier reconciliation table with inline search override & 'Tạo thuốc mới' option, atomic stock batch ingestion RPC, persistent alias memory in medicine_aliases, and live cache invalidation via invalidateMedicineCatalog().

recent_changes.description: Implemented Phase 01: Database Alias Storage & Atomic Batch Ingestion. Created medicine_aliases table with tenant RLS, getMedicineAliases and saveMedicineAliases server actions, and atomic import_medicine_stock_batch RPC with row locking and audit logging.

Implemented Phase 02: Spreadsheet Parser & Multi-Layer Pharma Matching Engine. Created excelParser.ts (.xlsx, .xls, .csv with Vietnamese number parsing), pharmaNormalizer.ts (dosage token preservation and pharma stopword removal), and pharmaMatcher.ts (4-tier matcher with LASA conflict prevention).

Implemented Phase 03: Interactive Reconciliation Modal & Catalog Sync. Added 'Nhập thuốc' button to MedicineList.tsx, created MedicineImportModal.tsx with dropzone, 3-tier review table, inline search autocomplete override, new medicine toggle, batch commit pipeline, alias learning, and cache invalidation.

errors_encountered.error: jsdom File.prototype.arrayBuffer is undefined in Vitest environment during parseSpreadsheet(file).
errors_encountered.solution: Added defensive FileReader fallback in excelParser.ts so it supports both modern browser File.arrayBuffer() and jsdom FileReader.

errors_encountered.error: Testing Library getByText matched multiple duplicate texts where Excel raw name matched clinic medicine name (e.g. ATErsin).
errors_encountered.solution: Refined test assertions in phase-03-medicine-import-ui.test.tsx to use getAllByText and element targeting.

decisions_made.decision: Enforce strict dosage token matching in pharmaMatcher to protect against LASA errors
decisions_made.reason: Prevent dangerous clinical errors where different strengths (e.g. Augbactam 281.25mg vs 500mg) would be auto-merged by naive string similarity.

decisions_made.decision: Use inline table cell autocomplete search override rather than floating absolute popover
decisions_made.reason: Avoids dropdown clipping inside scrollable table/modal containers and ensures smooth keyboard and click navigation.

decisions_made.decision: Persist user-confirmed mappings to medicine_aliases upon batch import
decisions_made.reason: Implements persistent alias learning per clinic so subsequent imports of identical supplier spreadsheets achieve 100% automated confidence.
